author: Latham, 1790
summary: 우리나라에서는 미조로 알려진 따오기류로, 제주도에서 관찰된 기록이 있다. 해안이나 늪지, 못가에 살며 물고기, 개구리, 물속 곤충, 조개 따위를 먹는다. 중국 남부, 인도차이나, 인도에 분포한다. 날개 길이는 34~37cm, 부리 길이는 13.5~17.5cm이다.

points.en: bare black skin on head and neck
long plumes hanging like a tassel in front of the neck

young: 어린새는 머리와 목이 짧은 깃털로 덮여 있어 어른새처럼 검은 맨살이 드러나지 않고, 날개와 등에 갈색빛 도는 회색 얼룩이 있다.

similar.how: 생김새가 비슷하지만 검은머리흰따오기는 머리와 목에 검은 피부가 드러나 있다.

art.subject: Black-headed Ibis (Threskiornis melanocephalus), adult in breeding plumage, as on a Jeju marsh in late spring: head and upper neck naked, with smooth black skin; the rest of the plumage white, with a tassel of long, loose white plumes hanging from the lower foreneck over the breast, and long, loose bluish-grey plumes on the scapulars and tertials draping over the closed wing and tail. Bill long, thick at the base and curved downward along its whole length, black; legs and feet black.
art.pose: wading in shallow marsh water, side view
art.scene: Jeju coastal marsh in late spring with shallow pools and fresh green sedges; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding, side view standing: white body, bald black head and upper neck, long black bill curved downward along its whole length, loose white tassel plumes on the lower foreneck, bluish-grey plumes over the scapulars and tertials, black legs

adult breeding, head and neck detail, side view: smooth bare black skin of the head and neck ending sharply at the white neck feathers, thick-based decurved black bill, long white tassel plumes hanging in front of the neck
art.build: Large white ibis, larger than a Little Egret and smaller than a Grey Heron, with a heavy body, a fairly short neck for its size and a bald black head. Bill black, about twice the head length, thick at the base and curving downward evenly from base to tip. Legs black, medium-long. At rest the grey tertial plumes droop over the wingtips and tail. In flight neck and legs outstretched, wings white, with a strip of bare red skin on the underwing.
avoid: Do not paint a red face, red legs or a shaggy crest — that is Crested Ibis (Nipponia nippon); this species has a bald black head and black legs.
Do not feather the head or neck; the black is bare skin.
Do not make the bill straight or curved only at the tip; it curves along its whole length.
Do not flatten the bill tip like a spoonbill.
